item.title: Bulletin updated at 00:50 HKT 19/Nov/2025
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Under the influence of the intense northeast monsoon, it will be windy over the coast of Guangdong today. A broad band of clouds will cover southern China today and tomorrow. It will be rather cool in the morning over the coastal areas and cold over inland areas. As the broad band of clouds thinning out and the northeast monsoon moderating, the weather will improve with temperatures rising gradually over southern China in the latter part of this week. However, it will still be cool in the morning. Under the influence of the dry monsoon, it will be generally fine over southern China early next week. The temperature difference between day and night will be rather large.

Date/Month: 19/11 (Wednesday)

Weather: Mainly cloudy and cool. One or two light rain patches at first. Very dry during the day.
